test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to the Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Login with locked out user
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.

test_cases.test_case: Login with empty Username field
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username is required.

test_cases.test_case: Login with empty Password field
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Password is required.

test_cases.test_case: Login with invalid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.

test_cases.test_case: Login with empty fields
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: 1. Leave both Username and Password fields empty
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username is required.

test_cases.test_case: Login with maximum length username
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to the Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Login with minimum length username
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.

test_cases.test_case: View product detail by clicking product name
steps: 1. Click on a product name or image
test_cases.expected_result: Product Detail page opens displaying product information

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Add to cart' button for a product
test_cases.expected_result: Item is added to cart and button changes to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
preconditions: Product has been added to cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Remove' button for the product
2. Observe the button change back to 'Add to cart'
test_cases.expected_result: Item is removed from cart and button changes back to 'Add to cart'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to view product detail without clicking
steps: 1. Do not click on any product name or image
test_cases.expected_result: Product Detail page does not open

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart when already in cart
preconditions: Product has been added to cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Add to cart' button for the product again
test_cases.expected_result: Button remains 'Remove' and item count in cart does not increase

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart when not in cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Remove' button for the product
test_cases.expected_result: Button remains 'Add to cart' and no action is performed

test_cases.test_case: Add product with zero price to cart
preconditions: Product list is displayed with a product priced at $0
steps: 1. Click on 'Add to cart' button for the product priced at $0
test_cases.expected_result: Item is added to cart and button changes to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Add product with maximum price to cart
preconditions: Product list is displayed with a product priced at maximum allowable value
steps: 1. Click on 'Add to cart' button for the product priced at maximum value
test_cases.expected_result: Item is added to cart and button changes to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by price low to high
test_cases.expected_result: Products are displayed in ascending order of price

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by name Z to A
test_cases.expected_result: Products are displayed in descending order by name

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Product added to cart confirmation message is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Product removed from cart confirmation message is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Go to Shopping Cart
steps: 2. Click on 'Go to Shopping Cart' button
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add product to cart when already in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Add to cart button is disabled or error message is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove product from cart when not in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Remove button is disabled or error message is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Check back button functionality
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page without any errors

test_cases.test_case: Check shopping cart navigation
steps: 2. Click on 'Go to Shopping Cart' button
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart page without any errors

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Continue Shopping
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Checkout
test_cases.expected_result: User begins the checkout process

test_cases.test_case: User removes an item from the cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Remove' button for an item
test_cases.expected_result: The item is removed from the cart

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Continue Shopping with empty cart
test_cases.expected_result: User remains on Shopping Cart page with a message indicating the cart is empty

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Checkout with empty cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is shown a message indicating that the cart is empty and cannot proceed to checkout

test_cases.test_case: User attempts to remove an item that is not in the cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Remove' button for an item that is not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: No action is taken, and a message indicates the item is not found in the cart

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Continue Shopping multiple times
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory page each time without errors

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Checkout multiple times
test_cases.expected_result: User begins the checkout process each time without errors

test_cases.test_case: User removes all items from the cart
steps: 1. Click on 'Remove' button for each item in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: All items are removed from the cart, and the cart is empty

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the overview step

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with missing First Name
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with missing Last Name
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Last Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with missing Zip/Postal Code
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Cancel Checkout Form
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with empty fields
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required', 'Error: Last Name is required', 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with maximum length names
steps: 1. Enter 'A very long first name that exceeds typical length' in First Name field
2. Enter 'A very long last name that exceeds typical length' in Last Name field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays validation error for First Name and Last Name

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with invalid Zip/Postal Code
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays validation error for Zip/Postal Code

test_cases.test_case: Complete the order successfully
preconditions: Items are present in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout Overview step
test_cases.expected_result: User is navigated to the confirmation page with order completion message

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout process
preconditions: Items are present in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout Overview step
test_cases.expected_result: User is exited from the checkout process and returned to the previous page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish order with empty cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout Overview step
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating that the cart is empty and cannot complete the order

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to cancel checkout without items
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout Overview step
test_cases.expected_result: User is still exited from the checkout process and returned to the previous page

test_cases.test_case: Check maximum items in order summary
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout Overview step
test_cases.expected_result: Order summary displays all items correctly without truncation

test_cases.test_case: Check total calculation with maximum values
preconditions: Cart contains items with maximum price
steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout Overview step
test_cases.expected_result: Totals section displays correct calculations for item total, tax, and total amount

test_cases.test_case: Display success message after order confirmation
test_cases.expected_result: Success message 'Thank you for your order!' is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Back Home button functionality
preconditions: User is on the confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory and the cart is cleared

test_cases.test_case: Back Home button is visible on confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: 'Back Home' button is visible and clickable

test_cases.test_case: Back Home button disabled when no order is completed
preconditions: User has not completed any order
test_cases.expected_result: 'Back Home' button is disabled or not present

test_cases.test_case: Success message is not displayed if order is not completed
preconditions: User has not completed any order
test_cases.expected_result: Success message is not displayed

test_cases.test_case: Boundary test for success message length
test_cases.expected_result: Success message does not exceed character limit and is fully displayed

test_cases.test_case: Successful logout redirects to login page
preconditions: User logged in as regular user
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Logout button is disabled when user is not logged in
steps: 1. Attempt to click on the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: Logout button is disabled and no action is taken

test_cases.test_case: Access protected pages after logout
preconditions: User logged in as regular user
steps: 1. Attempt to access the inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Logout action while session is active
preconditions: User logged in as regular user
steps: 1. Click on the Logout button multiple times in quick succession
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page only once

test_cases.test_case: Reset app state successfully
steps: 1. Click on the Reset Action button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart is cleared and in-app state is reset (cart badge and add/remove button states reflect the reset)

test_cases.test_case: Reset app state with empty cart
steps: 1. Click on the Reset Action button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart remains empty and in-app state is reset (cart badge and add/remove button states reflect the reset)

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset app state without being logged in
steps: 1. Click on the Reset Action button
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked and an error message is displayed indicating the user must log in first

test_cases.test_case: Reset app state with a large number of items
steps: 1. Click on the Reset Action button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart is cleared and in-app state is reset without performance issues

test_cases.test_case: Reset app state when already reset
steps: 1. Click on the Reset Action button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart remains empty and in-app state is reset (no change in state)
